activity.notes: Tvrtko was crowned king in October 1377, elevating the medieval Bosnian state from banate to kingdom. ANUBiH treats the coronation as a fundamental change in the rank of the Bosnian state. He remained king until his death on 10 March 1391. ATLAS therefore uses Kingdom of Bosnia as a distinct polity for the royal phase rather than extending the Banate of Bosnia label across the coronation.

sources.title: ANUBiH - Royal Charter of King Tvrtko I Kotromanić
sources.citation_text: Bosnian Academy study dates Tvrtko's coronation to October 1377 and states that Bosnia thereby entered the rank of kingdoms.

sources.title: ANUBiH - Historical Establishment of the Statehood of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.citation_text: ANUBiH study describes Tvrtko's reign 1353-1391 and the transformation of Bosnia into a kingdom in 1377.
